title: pilosella caespitosa var. suecica
intro: Pilosella caespitosa var. suecica, commonly known as Swedish Juniper or Arctic Ragwort, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Scandinavian countries, for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Swedish Juniper include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating respiratory and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella caespitosa var. suecica include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
